info.title: eharness team server
info.description: Team-agent server built on eharness (docs/plans/P32-team-example.md). Bearer token auth when TEAM_TOKEN is set; open otherwise.

tags.name: system
tags.description: Health.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Agent definitions (blueprints).

tags.name: persona
tags.description: The editable persona of an agent: identity, voice, operating rules; versions, proposals and revert.

tags.name: chats
tags.description: Sessions (`eharness/http`): chat thread sessions (`chat:<agentId>:<threadId>`, or `dm:<agentId>` for the first thread of an old agent) and task sessions: stream, resume, interrupt, history. Plus compact, stats and the tools menu of a thread.

tags.name: threads
tags.description: Chat threads per agent, all equal: new chat, rename, archive, and "Discuss in chat" (a new thread seeded with a briefing item, an alert or a run).

tags.name: briefings
tags.description: The daily digest as a page (one briefing per day) and the bell: urgent alerts and "briefing ready".

tags.name: library
tags.description: Shared files: agent artifacts, uploads, version history.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.description: Generated pages, documents, images, diagrams, tables and code with versions, signed content URLs, exports and public sharing (docs/plans/P45-team-artifacts.md).

tags.name: memory
tags.description: Workspace and per-agent memory files.

tags.name: settings
tags.description: Workspace settings read by the agent factory.

tags.name: providers
tags.description: Model providers: definitions with their form fields, saved profiles (secrets encrypted, never returned), connection tests and model lists with prices and context windows.

tags.name: routines
tags.description: Scheduled prompts per agent (multi-instance safe, on the durable inbox).

tags.name: rehearsals
tags.description: Test runs of a program on sample data in a safe mode (scratch files, simulated external writes, decisions recorded as "would ask") and the program test cases that re-run them after an edit.

tags.name: programs
tags.description: Standing orders: what an agent does on its own (brief, enforced authority, gates, budget, trigger), with run history.

tags.name: decisions
tags.description: The Decision Center: proposals (a plan or a program), escalations (a parked run asks) and amendments (a run asks for more authority), decided by the client.

tags.name: heartbeat
tags.description: The ambient monitor of an agent (silent unless something needs the client) and the daily digest of what ran, what waits and what it cost.

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Delegated work across agents (the board).

tags.name: approvals
tags.description: Approvals and questions waiting for a person, across sessions: the list and `POST /attention/{id}/answer`.

tags.name: logs
tags.description: Model call log: every provider call with timing, tokens, cost and payloads.

tags.name: events
tags.description: The feed of changes (`eharness/http` activity): JSON and SSE.

boot.description: Id of this server process; it changes on every restart.

enabled.description: `on` / `off` forces it; `inherit` (default) follows the connection: a workspace connection with `defaultEnabled` is available to every agent, an agent's own connection to that agent.

capabilities.description: Mode per capability id ("Read files", "Edit files").

tools.description: Mode per individual tool (Advanced). Rarely needed.

language.description: Default answer language (max 40); empty = the language of the person.

request.description: The words of the person that asked, as the agent quoted them.

about.description: One short line about what it is for (max 300).

language.description: Default answer language (max 40); empty = the language of the person.

mode.description: The mode the next tool call runs under. `manual`: risky tools ask a person. `auto`: rules first, then a classifier model allows or blocks (3 blocks in a row or 20 in total pause it and calls ask again). `bypass`: everything runs; deny rules and protected paths still apply.

source.description: `chat`: picked for this chat. `agent`: the agent's own mode. `workspace`: the Settings default.

agentMode.description: The agent's own mode (`inherit` = the workspace default). It is also the loosest mode its sessions may run in: an agent pinned to `manual` cannot be set to `auto` or `bypass`.

available.description: Modes `PUT` accepts now (the agent ceiling and classifier availability applied).

autoAvailable.description: False when the server has no classifier model (an offline scripted model): Auto is not offered.

paused.description: Auto was paused by repeated blocks: calls ask a person until one is approved (or Auto is picked again).

auto.description: Block counters of the live session on this instance.

UiMessage.description: The summary (kind) message; null when there was nothing to compact.

on.description: Offered to the model in this chat.

off.description: Connection ids switched off in this chat (replaces the previous list).

running.description: A turn runs in this process.

profileId.description: The provider profile the model is reached through.

pricing.description: USD per 1M tokens, from the model catalog.

model.description: The model of the agent; no pricing = unknown to the catalog.

activeTurn.description: The turn running anywhere (any instance), or null.

pending.description: Approvals and questions waiting for the user.

turns.description: Turns that ran at least one model step.

sessionId.description: The eharness session of the thread: `chat:<agentId>:<id>`, or `dm:<agentId>` for the thread that existed before threads did. Use it with `/sessions/{id}/…`.

title.description: Null until named: the first message names an unnamed thread.

source.description: Where the conversation lives. `channel` is reserved for messaging channels.

sourceLabel.description: Display label of the source, for example the name of a group.

ref.description: Id of the briefing, notification or task.

ThreadSeed.description: What a "Discuss in chat" thread was opened about.

ref.description: Briefing id, alert (notification) id or task id.

item.description: With a briefing: the index of one item of it.

agent.description: Agent id or slug; default the lead.

running.description: A turn runs, on any instance.

SessionSnapshot.description: The stored state of a session (`eharness/http`).

allOf.description: An AI SDK `UIMessage`. Stored messages carry `metadata.eharness` (turn id, stop reason, usage, pending approvals).

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` to read older messages; absent = the start.

duplicate.description: The same `Idempotency-Key` was delivered before: nothing was added.

ChatQueued.description: A turn of this chat runs on another instance: the message was stored in the durable inbox and is steered into it. Follow the turn with `GET /sessions/{id}/chat/stream`.

id.description: Chat id of `useChat`; ignored (the chat is the agent DM).

allOf.description: An AI SDK `UIMessage`. Stored messages carry `metadata.eharness` (turn id, stop reason, usage, pending approvals).

messages.description: Only the **last** message is read: a user message (send), or the assistant message with `approval-responded` / `output-available` tool parts (answers a pending approval; the continuation streams into the same message). Ids, metadata and history of the client are never trusted.

messageId.description: With a user message: replace that message and answer it (edit).

target.description: `local`: a turn of this instance was aborted; `remote`: the request was written for the instance running it; `idle`: nothing runs.

AttentionList.description: The library queue, without the app fields of `GET /approvals` (agent name, task, question texts).

id.description: `approvalId`, `toolCallId` (client tool, e.g. a question) or `waitId`: the `{id}` of `POST /attention/{id}/answer`.

agent.description: Slug of the agent that runs the session.

status.description: `recorded`: stored, others of the batch still wait (`remaining`). `resumed`: it was the last one and the session continues server side. `already-answered`: answered elsewhere first (refresh quietly).

reason.description: Shown to the model when denied.

note.description: A free-text note about this call: the model reads it right after the result (approved) or as part of the reason (denied).

remember.description: With `approved: true`: also allow this tool without asking for the rest of the session (and answer the other waiting calls of the same tool in this session at once). With `approved: false`: never allow it in this session.

scope.description: With `approved: true`: how far "always allow" reaches. `session` (default with `remember`): this session. `agent`: a saved rule of this agent, all its sessions. `all`: a saved rule of every agent. Tools a connector pins to ask (writes of third-party connectors) still ask.

answers.description: One answer per question, in order; null dismisses the questions.

answer.description: An approval decision, or the answer of an `ask_user_question`.

lastSeq.description: Cursor for the next call: the `seq` of the last event, else the current head.

resync.description: Present when `after` is older than the events kept by retention: some events were missed, refetch the state (agents, tasks, chats) and continue from `lastSeq`.

TeamEvent.description: App events: `message-added` (agent, role, preview), `task-changed` (taskId, status, pendingKind, title), `agent-message` (from, to, preview), `model-call` (id, kind, status, model; one per logged provider call, for the Logs page) and the change events. Session events come from `eharness/activity` (spec 25): `turn-started` (turnId, kind, source; every turn of every session, also server-started ones), `pending-changed` (a snapshot: `waiting` = approvals / questions that wait for a person, `[]` when nothing does), `approval-decided` (id, approved, by), `attention-answered`, `session-recovered`, `child-reported`.

url.description: Use as the `url` of a `file` part of the next user message; the server resolves it to the file content.

agentId.description: The agent that runs the task session.

parentSessionId.description: The session that delegated the task (the lead DM), if any.

brief.description: Work queue: what to do, in markdown (send-back notes are appended). null for tasks that did not come from the queue.

inputs.description: Library paths the task starts from.

createdBy.description: `client` or the id of the agent that queued it; null = not a work item (no Review step).

acceptedAt.description: When the client accepted the finished work. A done work item with a `done` or `partial` report and no `acceptedAt` is in Review.

round.description: 1, +1 every time the work was sent back.

hold.description: Queued only: the task does not start on its own; the client starts it.

review.description: Finished work waits in Review (client-made tasks by default). false: it goes straight to Done and the creator (an agent) reads the result.

queue.description: Queued tasks only (`GET /tasks`, `GET /tasks/{id}`): why it has not started. `hold`: held by the client. `worker`: an active worker program of the agent owns the queue. `slot`: the agent (or the team) works on its maximum already; it starts when one ends. `starting`: a slot is free, it starts now.

queueNote.description: Queued tasks only: when a `slot` wait is held by a task that waits for the client, a sentence naming it ("waiting: <task> needs your approval first"). null otherwise.

column.description: Where the board shows the task (`GET /tasks` and `GET /tasks/{id}`). `status` is what the session does; `column` adds what the client sees: a run parked on an open decision (`escalate`, `request_authority`) has `status: running` but `column: waiting`, a finished work item that is not accepted is `review`.

TaskStatus.description: `queued`: in the work queue, no session yet (a worker program takes it); `needs_action`: an approval or question waits for a person; `running` (also while a run is parked on a decision: see `column` of the task for `waiting`); `done`; `failed`; `stopped` (aborted); `interrupted` (its process stopped; continue it); `timed_out` (a delegation ran past its time limit).

outputs.description: Library paths of what the run produced.

TaskReport.description: The final report of a program run; null for other tasks and while it runs.

attempts.description: 1: checked once; 2: checked again after the one fix-up turn.

DeliverableResult.description: Deliverable checks of a program run; null when the program lists none.

path.description: The path after the tokens were resolved.

TaskGrants.description: Extra permissions given with the task on top of the agent's own; null = none.

allOf.description: An AI SDK `UIMessage`. Stored messages carry `metadata.eharness` (turn id, stop reason, usage, pending approvals).

messages.description: The stored messages of the task session (newest 200).

id.description: The approval id, or the tool call id of a question: the `{id}` of `POST /attention/{id}/answer`.

answeredWaiting.description: Items of this session that were answered already and wait for the others of the same batch (hidden from the list).

hold.description: Do not start on its own (default false: the task starts when the agent has a free slot).

review.description: Finished work waits in Review. Default true for the client.

allOf.description: Extra permissions for one task: tool names or rules, connectors (every tool), library path globs to read and to write. Pre-approved on top of what the agent has in chat.

hint.description: What happens next: it starts on its own, waits for a free slot of the agent, or (an active worker program of the agent) is picked up by that program at its next run.

note.description: What to change. Appended to the brief.

pending.description: Approvals / questions waiting in the DM.

delegated.description: Tasks this agent handed to others.

mode.description: `steer` (default): joins the running turn at its next step boundary (a queued turn when idle). `queue`: a turn of its own after the running one.

sessionMode.description: `dm`: the fire is appended to the agent DM chat. `task`: every fire runs in a new task session `routine:<id>:<slot>` (shows on the board).

overlap.description: `skip`: a fire is dropped while the previous one still runs or waits. `queue`: it queues behind.

catchUpWindowMs.description: null: fires missed during downtime are skipped. Else the latest missed slot fires once when it is younger than this.

maxFailures.description: The routine pauses itself at this many.

programId.description: Set when a program owns this routine (the schedule of the program).

RoutineSpec.description: `cron` (5 or 6 fields, IANA timezone, croner syntax), `every` (interval in ms, at least 10 s) or `at` (one shot).

createdBy.description: The agent that wrote the file last; null = a person (an upload or the editor).

by.description: Who made the change; null = a person.

ifVersion.description: Omitted: overwrite. `null`: create only (409 `FILE_EXISTS`). A version: write only when the file still has it (409 `VERSION_CONFLICT`, `details.currentVersion`).

kind.description: html, document, image, mermaid, code, data or file (an unknown kind renders as file).

dir.description: The library folder with the files. Empty on the public share page.

shareUrl.description: The public page `<web>/s/<token>`; null while private.

shareVersion.description: null = the public link follows the latest version.

files.description: The files of the current version.

origin.description: Where it came from ("Save as artifact" of a fence in a message).

url.description: Absolute content URL (`/art/v/<id>/<version>/~<token>/<path>`; relative links inside a page keep working). No cookie needed.

expiresAt.description: Epoch ms; ask again after it (a 403 means expired).

path.description: A file inside the folder; default: the entry.

visibility.description: private -> public issues a NEW link; public -> private kills it.

shareVersion.description: Pin the public link to a version; null = follow the latest. Public artifacts only.

ifVersion.description: The library version of the entry file you edited (`GET /library/file`). A stale edit gets 409 `VERSION_CONFLICT` (`error.details.currentVersion`).

entryUrl.description: Public content URL of the entry file (CORS open, no login).

baseUrl.description: Public content URL prefix of the folder; append a relative file path.

defaultPermissionMode.description: The workspace default permission mode: `default` = Manual, `auto` = Auto (classifier), `bypassPermissions` = Bypass. The mode of every chat and agent that has none of its own; read on every tool call.

toolAccess.description: Tool access of agents without their own setting: `auto` or `on-demand` (third-party connector tools found with `tool_search`).

budgetUsd.description: Monthly USD limit of the workspace budget ledger; null = tracked, not limited.

spawnCap.description: Children the lead runs at once (`subagents` `maxConcurrent`).

defaultModel.description: Model id of agents without their own; null = the default model of the default profile.

defaultProfile.description: Provider profile of agents without their own pick; null = the server default (the env profile, else the first enabled one).

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the team (default: the `TZ` variable or the host timezone). The default of the heartbeat active hours and of the daily digest time; an agent heartbeat or the digest can override it.

python.description: Python version of the interpreter; null when off, unknown or inside docker.

isolated.description: True when the code runs under an OS sandbox or in a container, without network.

remote.description: The Remote sandbox connector when one is connected (host of its URL, never the token); null when it is not reachable.

defaultModel.description: A model id, or the legacy `profile:model` (split when the prefix names a profile).

month.description: Spend and limit of the workspace budget this month (UTC), from the budget ledger: not limited by log retention, the same numbers as the briefing cost line.

since.description: Start of the oldest call still in the call log; `total`, `bySource` and `agents` cover from then on (older calls are pruned).

calls.description: Model calls (the unit of the Logs page).

count.description: Chat and heartbeat: turns that called a model. The others: runs.

calls.description: Model calls (the unit of the Logs page).

fields.description: The settings form, in display order. Render it with any form component.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema of the settings (input shape) the fields were derived from.

envMap.description: Settings field -> environment variable that creates a read-only `env` profile.

path.description: Dotted path in the settings object.

widget.description: Suggested input; absent = the default of the kind.

secret.description: The value is a secret: shown as `{ set, hint }`, kept when an edit omits it, sent as plain text only when changed.

secretValues.description: A `keyvalue` field whose values are secrets (header values).

group.description: Where the field goes in the form; `advanced` is collapsed by default.

showWhen.description: Show the field only while another field has this value.

envHint.description: Environment variable that can supply it.

source.description: `env`: created from environment variables, read-only. `store`: saved in the database, secrets encrypted.

settings.description: The settings with every secret replaced by `{ set, hint? }` (headers: one per key).

isDefault.description: The profile agents without their own pick use.

defaultModel.description: The model an agent on this profile uses when it names none (`TEAM_MODEL` on the env default profile, else the provider default).

id.description: Profile id: letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`; no `:`. Default: the provider id, then `-2`, `-3`, ...

settings.description: Settings by the definition fields; secrets in plain text (stored encrypted).

source.description: Where the entry comes from: added by hand, the provider API, or the public catalog.

enabled.description: Only with `all=true`: false when the profile's `models.allow` / `models.deny` hides the model (agents cannot pick it).

icon.description: An icon name the UI resolves.

publisher.description: Who makes or runs the service.

fields.description: The settings form of the connector.

builtin.description: Included: there is no connect step.

redirectUri.description: Register this callback URL with the OAuth app.

defaultEnabled.description: Workspace scope: every agent has the connection unless it opts out.

capabilities.description: Discovered at connect time (replace the connector list).

settings.description: Secrets are `{ set, hint? }`; the value is never returned.

custom.description: A custom (remote MCP) connection: its own connector in the directory, under the name its user gave it.

mode.description: `all`: every agent has it unless it opts out. `selected`: only `agentIds` (empty: registered, not used yet). An agent-scoped connection is `selected` with its one agent.

excludedAgentIds.description: `all` mode: agents that turned it off.

ConnectionAccess.description: Which agents use it (absent for built-in connections).

detected.description: `oauth`: the server answered 401, sign in needed. `none`: it answered without credentials. `unknown`: could not tell (unreachable, other status).

dynamicRegistration.description: The server registers clients itself: no client id needed.

values.description: Current values; a secret is `{ set, hint? }`.

url.description: What the QR code encodes (a login token such as `tg://login?token=...`); it may change under the same `viewId` while the view is polled.

FlowView.description: What to show now. A closed vocabulary: render by `type`. Every action quotes the `viewId` of the view it answers.

signIn.description: `now`: sign in right after adding (the response carries the OAuth `flow` to open). `later`: saved as needs-auth, signed in when needed. `none`: no sign in; tools are discovered now.

oauthClient.description: Your own OAuth client (otherwise the server registers one).

headers.description: Request headers; values are secrets, stored encrypted.

agentIds.description: Workspace scope without `availableToAll`: the agents that use it from the start (none by default: registered, not used yet).

allOf.description: Set once the flow finished and the connection was saved.

definitionId.description: Connect a new connection of this connector.

scopeId.description: The agent id or slug (agent scope).

defaultEnabled.description: Workspace scope: available to all agents. Default false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code (eharness codes pass through).

allOf.description: The current state of the flow: re-render it (nothing is lost).

data.description: `form`: the values (a secret may be `{ keep: true }`); `choose`: `{ selected }`.

enabled.description: False switches the connection off for everyone.

settings.description: Keep-secret semantics: a secret omitted, `""` or `{ "keep": true }` keeps the stored value; `null` removes a value.

defaultModes.description: Default mode per capability for agents that do not choose.

agentIds.description: `selected`: the agents that use the connection (ids or slugs).

excludedAgentIds.description: `all`: the agents that opt out. Omitted: keep the current ones.

enabled.description: Whether the agent uses it now.

allOf.description: The mode without this agent's choice.

pinned.description: Always asks, even in Bypass mode (write or destructive, not built in).

agentTools.description: The names this agent calls the capability's tools by (`<connection>_<tool>` when the connection prefixes its tools). Programs name tools by these. Absent until the agent has been prepared.

connections.description: Connection id to its new choices (replaces that entry); `null` removes it (back to inherit).

reminders.description: Reminders created from chats (`sys:reminder:*` routines): active ones and the recent finished ones, newest first. Cancel with `DELETE /channels/connections/{id}/reminders/{reminderId}`. The heartbeat and digest routines are not listed (they have their own pages).

place.description: `<chat>/<topic>` where it posts, or `This chat` for a reminder of a web chat thread.

sessionId.description: A reminder made in a web chat thread (`connectionId` `web`): the thread it is delivered into.

nextAt.description: The next fire of an active reminder (epoch ms; one-time or repeating).

whenText.description: The schedule in words with the absolute time and zone.

sessionMode.description: `dm`: the fire is appended to the agent DM chat. `task`: every fire runs in a new task session `routine:<id>:<slot>` (shows on the board).

overlap.description: `skip`: a fire is dropped while the previous one still runs or waits. `queue`: it queues behind.

RoutineQueue.description: The inputs waiting in the session that keeps the routine from firing (overlap: an input of the session is still queued).

sessionMode.description: `dm`: the fire is appended to the agent DM chat. `task`: every fire runs in a new task session `routine:<id>:<slot>` (shows on the board).

overlap.description: `skip`: a fire is dropped while the previous one still runs or waits. `queue`: it queues behind.

version.description: The `version` the editor loaded; a different current version answers 409 `VERSION_CONFLICT`.

gates.description: Actions that still need the client (told to the agent; decisions come in a later phase).

forbidden.description: Rules or tool names denied in every case (deny rules of the permission engine).

report.description: `digest`: a line in the client digest; `task`: the run on the board; `silent`: nothing beyond the run history.

deliverables.description: Files each run must leave in the library; checked when the run ends.

notes.description: Standing agreements: what the client and the agent agreed about this program. Told to every run after the brief. They never grant authority or lift a gate.

createdBy.description: `client`, or the id of the proposing agent.

warnings.description: Only on the answers of create and update: see `ProgramWarning`.

status.description: `granted`: usable; `gate`: a write of a third-party connector, refused until the client decides; `off`: connector mode Off; `unavailable`: the agent has no such tool.
`granted`: usable; `gate`: a write of a third-party connector, refused until the client decides; `off`: connector mode Off; `unavailable`: the agent has no such tool.

grant.description: The effective grant of the authority (null when the agent is not activated).

tools.description: Tool names or permission rule specifiers the run may use (`web_fetch`, `Bash(git status)`, `WebFetch(domain:example.com)`). Enforced by the permission engine.

connectors.description: Connector or connection ids: every tool of them is allowed.

read.description: Library path globs the run may read (`/library/data/**`).

write.description: Library path globs the run may write (`/library/reports/**`); they are readable too.

perRunUsd.description: One run stops (`cost-cap`) when it has spent this much. null = no limit.

perDayUsd.description: All runs of the program in one UTC day stop at this spend (ledger scope `program:<id>:<day>`). null = no limit.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output tokens one model call of a run may produce. Every call reserves its worst case (context + this cap at the model price) against the budgets before it runs, so a small cap is what lets a small budget work. null / absent: sized from the budget (at most 16 384).

ProgramTrigger.description: `manual`: runs only on "run now". `schedule`: the routine scheduler fires it (same claim, overlap, recovery and failure rules as routines).

post.summary: Send a message, answer an approval or regenerate (useChat)
post.description:
`eharness/http` (spec 26 §5). The body is an AI SDK `useChat` request; the response is the UI message stream (`text/event-stream`).

- **Send**: the last message is a user message. Attachments are `file` parts (`data:` / `https:` URLs, or the `library:///uploads/…` url returned by `POST /library/files`; media type and reference are checked here).
- **Approvals**: a client that posts the assistant message back with the part in `approval-responded` continues into the **same** message id (the web app answers through `POST /attention/{id}/answer` instead). A message none of whose answers is waiting any more is `409 EH_HTTP_ALREADY_ANSWERED`.
- **Regenerate / edit**: `trigger: "regenerate-message"`, or a user message with `messageId`.
- **Idempotency**: the `Idempotency-Key` header, else the user message id; a repeat is `409 EH_HTTP_DUPLICATE_REQUEST` (with `details.active` and the turn).

Busy policy (`?ifBusy=`, default `steer`): while a turn of this chat runs, a new user message is **steered** into it: on this instance the response follows the running turn; when another instance runs it the message goes through the durable inbox and the route answers `202`. `reject` answers `409 EH_SESSION_BUSY`. Approvals, regenerate and edit never steer: `409`.

patch.summary: Set the settings of a chat or topic
patch.description: Writes settings on one node (`chatId` is the node id of a chat or of a forum topic): `enabled` (allowlist), `wake` (`mention`, `always`, `never` = observe only), `delivery`, `retentionDays`, `agentId`, `observe`, `sessionScope`, `redactOnDelete`. Settings inherit down the tree: a topic keeps what its forum sets unless it sets its own. A `null` field clears the setting (inherit again); a chat that gets settings and has no `enabled` yet is switched on.
